@everyone


 INTRODUCING RISE MEDIA MISSIONS
,
Create. Get featured. Get discovered.

We're looking for creators to help show the world what’s happening inside Infinity Rising. Submit your best content for a chance to be featured across official Infinity Rising marketing, social media, trailers, and promotions, while helping new audiences discover your work.


 RISE MEDIA MISSION #001: APARTMENT BUILDS
,
We've seen some incredible community builds. Now we want to see yours.

Show off your best apartment builds with an edited short-form or long-form video. Multiple submissions are welcome and encouraged!

The Infinity Rising team will review submissions and select standout content for potential use across our channels.


 CAPTURE STANDARDS
,
For the best chance of being featured:


4K preferred (1080p minimum)
,
60 FPS preferred (30 FPS minimum)
,
Ultra settings preferred (High minimum)
,
Hardware Lumen enabled
,
16:9 preferred
,
Total File Size under 100 MB
,
MP4 file format
,
Submit edited footage
,
Get to the action quickly and end cleanly
,
Keep camera movement smooth and intentional
,
Use good lighting and capture cinematic shots whenever possible
,

For outdoor shots, angled lighting parallel to the camera plane is ideal. For apartment footage, make sure your build is properly lit.


 SUBMIT YOUR MEDIA
,
Upload here: https://inboxes.pics.io/ir-community-inbox


Click Upload File and select your video.
,
Complete ALL fields on the right:
,

   
Title: Short and descriptive
Description: Include what we're seeing, location, gear, vehicles, outfits, time of day, and other useful details
,
Creator: Your Discord username so we can credit you
,
CopyrightFlag: Check this box to give Infinity Rising permission to use your content for marketing and promotional purposes
,
,
Double-check everything and click the yellow Import button.
,

That's it. You're done... until the next Media Mission. 

Creator content is going to play a growing role in how we showcase Infinity Rising, and we're building new ways for the community to discover, support, and amplify the creators behind it.

Your content can help fuel the growth of Infinity Rising. Let's show everyone what this community can create. (edited)

DESIGN THE NEXT INFINITY RISING WEAPON

Do you have an idea for an in-game weapon you'd love to see in Infinity Rising? Now's your chance to create it. Anything goes. Bring us your wildest weapon concepts sketches, renders, AI concepts, or whatever helps bring your idea to life.

If your concept is selected, the dev team will use your inspiration to bring it to life in-game, forever becoming part of Infinity Rising and the winner will receive that item for FREE. Enter as often as you like.

Submit now through September 30th here: https://inboxes.pics.io/ir-community-inbox

 THE GAME DIRECTOR UPDATE IS HERE!
,
Want a little more insight into what’s happening behind the scenes with Infinity Rising?

Our Game Director, David, is kicking off a new periodic Game Director Update, where he’ll share his thoughts and perspective on a variety of topics surrounding the game, development, and where we’re headed.

 And this isn’t just a one-way update.

Make sure you read all the way to the end. David has some questions for the community, and we want to hear what you think.

Read the update, then join the conversation and share your questions/answers here:
⁠director-update-questions (edited)

TO THE CLOUDS

The sky is no longer just the backdrop.

Free Flight is coming to Infinity Rising in the next release, opening the world above like never before.

Alongside it comes an all-new lighting pass and a completely new cloud system — reshaping the atmosphere, scale, and feeling of the world from the ground all the way to the clouds.

This is in-engine footage.

This is Infinity Rising.

To the Clouds.
